# Smart Choice Tour and Travels

> Best travel agency in Haridwar, Uttarakhand. We offer Char Dham Yatra packages, Kedarnath tour packages, Mussoorie & Nainital trips, Dehradun airport transfers, and affordable taxi services across North India.

## Tour Packages

- [Char Dham Yatra Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/char-dham-yatra): 10-12 Days complete spiritual journey to Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath from Haridwar.
- [Do Dham Yatra Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/do-dham-yatra): 5-7 Days pilgrimage covering Kedarnath and Badrinath from Haridwar.
- [Kedarnath Tour Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/kedarnath): 3 Nights / 4 Days holy trip to Kedarnath Dham with optional helicopter service.
- [Badrinath Tour Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/badrinath): 3 Days tour to Lord Vishnu's shrine in Badrinath.
- [Mussoorie Tour Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/mussoorie): 3 Days hill station tour to Kempty Falls, Mall Road, and Gun Hill.
- [Nainital Tour Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/nainital): 3 Days lake tour to Naini Lake, Naina Devi Temple, and Bhimtal.
- [Rishikesh Tour Package](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/rishikesh): 2 Days adventure and yoga retreat covering river rafting, Triveni Ghat Ganga Aarti, and Laxman Jhula.
- [Haridwar Local Sightseeing](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/packages/haridwar-sightseeing): 1 Day local tour of Har Ki Pauri, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi, and Bharat Mata Mandir.

## Taxi & Transport Services

- [Taxi & Car Rental Services](https://www.thesmartchoicetours.com/cars): Outstation taxi booking, Dehradun Airport transfers, Dzire, Ertiga, Innova Crysta, and Tempo Traveller hire in Haridwar.
